label: Pecorino della Garfagnana e delle Colline Lucchesi

about.text: A sheep's pecorino from the Garfagnana and the Colline Lucchesi, in Tuscany, also called baccellone. Historically it was made with mixed milk and cardoon thistle as rennet.

sources.text: Listed as a sheep cheese from Tuscany; the Cucina toscana article gives mixed milk and cardoon rennet, historically; Table 1 names Pecorino Baccellone under Tuscany.
